items.title: Grammar 1–3 · My Dream

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain or clarify something already stated using 可以說是.
grammarPages.explanation: This phrase is used to further explain or clarify something already stated. 可以說是 and 可說是 have the same meaning.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 可以說是 / 可說是 + Noun / Predicate

items.question: Can 可以說是 mean physical ability to speak?
items.answer: No. 可以說是 means 'practically / you could say'; use 可以說 without 是 for ability or permission to speak.

right.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ shuō yí jù zhōngwén.
right.english: I can speak a sentence of Chinese.

items.question: Does 可以說是 replace normal 是 in direct facts?
items.answer: Use 可以說是 to soften a description or summarize; use ordinary 是 for direct factual identities.

right.pinyin: Tā zhēnde shì wǒ gēge.
right.english: He really is my older brother.

text.traditional: 你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí ō, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I'm a fan of yours, quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 他下個月就滿十八歲了，可以說是一個大人了。
text.simplified: 他下个月就满十八岁了，可以说是一个大人了。
text.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè jiù mǎn shíbā suì le, kěyǐ shuō shì yí ge dàrén le.
text.english: He will turn eighteen next month; you could say he is an adult now.

text.traditional: 我在高雄住了十年了，這裡可說是我第二個家。
text.simplified: 我在高雄住了十年了，这里可说是我第二个家。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Gāoxióng zhù le shí nián le, zhèlǐ kě shuō shì wǒ dì èr ge jiā.
text.english: I have lived in Kaohsiung for ten years; this place can be called my second home.

questions.prompt: 小王在學校很受歡迎，成績好又會彈吉他，大家常說他是學校的明星人物。

result.traditional: 他學了三年中文，現在可以說是個中國通了。
result.simplified: 他学了三年中文，现在可以说是个中国通了。
result.pinyin: Tā xué le sān nián zhōngwén, xiànzài kěyǐ shuō shì ge zhōngguótōng le.
result.english: He has studied Chinese for three years; you could say he is an expert on China now.

repairs.note: 多麼 is an exclamatory degree adverb, not used before noun phrases.
再說 introduces an additional reason, not a descriptive summary.
算了吧 expresses resignation or dropping an idea, which contradicts the sentence context.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express feelings that exceed expectations using 多麼…啊.
grammarPages.explanation: This construction indicates an exclamation when something exceeds one's expectations. In casual speech, 麼 can be dropped (多…啊).

items.question: Can 多麼 ask for quantity or cost?
items.answer: No. 多麼 is exclusively an exclamation of degree ('how...!'); use 多少 to ask for prices or quantities.

right.pinyin: Zhè běn shū duōshǎo qián?
right.english: How much is this book?

items.question: Does 多麼 modify a noun directly?
items.answer: 多麼 modifies adjectives/stative verbs, not bare nouns; say 多麼好 instead of 多麼人.

right.pinyin: Tā shì duóme hǎo de rén a!
right.english: What a wonderful person he is!

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看，不當演員多麼可惜啊！
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看，不当演员多么可惜啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎng de zhème hǎokàn, bù dāng yǎnyuán duōme kěxī a!
text.english: You are so good-looking; how regrettable it would be if you didn't become an actor!

text.traditional: 那隻狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵長長的，多可愛啊！
text.simplified: 那只狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵长长的，多可爱啊！
text.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu de yǎnjīng dàdà de, ěrduo chángcháng de, duō kě'ài a!
text.english: That dog has big eyes and long ears; how cute it is!

text.traditional: 外面熱死了，我在家邊看電視邊吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.simplified: 外面热死了，我在家边看电视边吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn rè sǐ le, wǒ zài jiā biān kàn diànshì biān chī mángguǒ bīng, duō shūfu a!
text.english: It's scorching outside; eating mango ice while watching TV at home, how comfortable!

questions.prompt: 看到滿山盛開的櫻花，大家忍不住讚嘆：這裡風景___美麗啊！

segments.traditional: 能遇到這麼有愛心的好老師，我們

result.traditional: 能遇到這麼有愛心的好老師，我們多麼幸運啊！
result.simplified: 能遇到这么有爱心的好老师，我们多么幸运啊！
result.pinyin: Néng yùdào zhème yǒu àixīn de hǎo lǎoshī, wǒmen duōme xìngyùn a!
result.english: To meet such a caring teacher, how fortunate we are!

repairs.note: 可以說是 means "you could say that", which does not fit this slot.
算了吧 expresses resignation or dropping an idea, which contradicts the sentence context.
順便 means "in passing / conveniently", which requires an action done alongside a primary task.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add an additional reason or explanation using 再說.
grammarPages.explanation: 再說 is used as a conjunction. The sentence following 再說 reinforces the preceding sentence with an additional reason.

items.question: Can 再說 alone mean 'say it again'?
items.answer: As a conjunction adding reasons, 再說 introduces a clause; to ask someone to repeat, say 請再說一次.

right.pinyin: Qǐng zài shuō yí cì, wǒ méi tīngdǒng.
right.english: Please say it once again, I didn't understand.

items.question: Where does conjunction 再說 sit in the sentence?
items.answer: 再說 sits at the beginning of the reinforcing clause, never at the very end.

right.traditional: 我不想去，再說我也沒有錢。
right.simplified: 我不想去，再说我也没有钱。
right.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù, zàishuō wǒ yě méiyǒu qián.
right.english: I don't want to go; besides, I have no money.

text.traditional: 不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Bù dāng yǎnyuán duōme kěxī a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: How regrettable if you don't become an actor! Besides, audiences really appreciate your performance.

text.traditional: 最近得交兩個報告，再說，快期末考了，下星期的旅遊我不去了。
text.simplified: 最近得交两个报告，再说，快期末考了，下星期的旅游我不去了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn děi jiāo liǎng ge bàogào, zàishuō, kuài qīmòkǎo le, xià xīngqī de lǚyóu wǒ bú qù le.
text.english: I have to hand in two reports recently; moreover, final exams are coming, so I won't go on the trip next week.

text.traditional: 參加社團活動能交到不少朋友，再說，還能讓我們更了解自己。
text.simplified: 参加社团活动能交到不少朋友，再说，还能让我们更了解自己。
text.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng néng jiāodào bù shǎo péngyǒu, zàishuō, hái néng ràng wǒmen gèng liǎojiě zìjǐ.
text.english: Joining clubs lets you make friends; furthermore, it helps us understand ourselves better.

items.prompt: Giving reasons not to go out in bad weather:

segments.traditional: 快下大雨了，我們別出門了吧。

result.traditional: 外面冷得很，再說快下大雨了，我們別出門了吧。
result.simplified: 外面冷得很，再说快下大雨了，我们别出门了吧。
result.pinyin: Wàimiàn lěng de hěn, zàishuō kuài xià dàyǔ le, wǒmen bié chūmén le ba.
result.english: It's freezing outside; besides, it's about to pour rain, let's not go out.

repairs.note: 可以說是 means "you could say that", which does not fit this slot.
多麼 is an exclamatory degree adverb, not used before noun phrases.
算了 expresses resignation or dropping an idea, which contradicts the sentence context.

dialogue.title: 對話 · Dialogue
dialogue.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

text.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 东賢，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.english: Dongxian, I never thought that after only two years, you are already a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
text.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
text.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
text.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
text.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

text.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
text.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

text.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
text.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计画？
text.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

text.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
text.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
text.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

text.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.english: Director? You look so handsome, are tall enough, and act well in every role; how regrettable it would be if you didn't become an actor! Besides, audiences highly recognize your performance.

text.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
text.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
text.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

text.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
text.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
text.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

text.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老闆什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect two clauses showing causal result or contrast using 而.
grammarPages.explanation: 而 connects two clauses, often indicating a transition, contrast, or cause-and-effect relationship in formal writing.

items.question: Can 而 connect two nouns like 和?
items.answer: No. 而 connects two clauses or verb phrases; use 和 or 跟 to connect nouns.

right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi píngguǒ hé xiāngjiāo.
right.english: I want to buy apples and bananas.

items.question: Where is 而 placed between two clauses?
items.answer: 而 stands before the second verb or predicate clause, not before the subject.
items.wrongTraditional: 他很聰明，而大家都喜歡他。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很聪明，而大家都喜欢他。

right.pinyin: Tā cōngmíng érqiě shànliáng.
right.english: He is smart and also kind.

text.traditional: 東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定。
text.simplified: 东賢的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定。
text.pinyin: Dōngxián de fùmǔ yīnwèi dānxīn tā de wèilái ér fǎnduì zhège juédìng.
text.english: Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future.

text.traditional: 他因為不適應都市緊張的生活，而搬到了鄉下，過著簡單的日子。
text.simplified: 他因为不适应都市紧张的生活，而搬到了乡下，过着简单的日子。
text.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi bù shìyìng dūshì jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó, ér bāndào le xiāngxià, guò zhe jiǎndān de rìzi.
text.english: Because he couldn't adapt to the stressful city life, he moved to the countryside and lives a simple life.

text.traditional: 有些人追求名利，而有些人更重視內心的平靜與快樂。
text.simplified: 有些人追求名利，而有些人更重视内心的平静与快乐。
text.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén zhuīqiú mínglì, ér yǒuxiē rén gèng zhòngshì nèixīn de píngjìng yǔ kuàilè.
text.english: Some people pursue fame and fortune, whereas some value inner peace and happiness more.

questions.prompt: 哥哥因為工作認真有實力，___獲得了升職的機會。

result.traditional: 他因為熱愛中華文化，而決定到臺灣留學。
result.simplified: 他因为热爱中华文化，而决定到台湾留学。
result.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi rè'ài zhōnghuá wénhuà, ér juédìng dào Táiwān liúxué.
result.english: Because he loves Chinese culture, he decided to study in Taiwan.

repairs.note: 再說 introduces an additional reason, not a descriptive summary.
多麼 is an exclamatory degree adverb, not used before noun phrases.
可以說是 means "you could say that", which does not fit this slot.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express producing a new creation or result through an action using V出.
grammarPages.explanation: When 出 follows a verb here, it indicates that a new item or creative result is produced through the action (e.g. 寫出, 畫出, 做不出).

items.question: Does V出 mean physical movement out of a place?
items.answer: V出 here emphasizes creating or bringing an idea into reality (想出, 寫出); physical emergence uses 走出來.

right.pinyin: Tā cóng fángjiān zǒu chūlái le.
right.english: He walked out from the room.

items.question: Can any verb take 出 to mean production?
items.answer: Only verbs of creation or cognition take productive 出 (想出, 做出, 畫出, 寫出).

right.pinyin: Tā huà chū le yì zhāng huà.
right.english: He painted a picture.

text.traditional: 只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。
text.simplified: 只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。
text.pinyin: Zhǐyào búduàn nǔlì, jiù yídìng néng huà chū jīngcǎi de rénshēng.
text.english: As long as you strive continuously, you will definitely paint a splendid life.

text.traditional: 他花了三年的時間，最後寫出了一本大家都非常喜愛的小說。
text.simplified: 他花了三年的时间，最后写出了一本大家都非常喜爱的小说。
text.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián de shíjiān, zuìhòu xiě chū le yì běn dàjiā dōu fēicháng xǐ'ài de xiǎoshuō.
text.english: He spent three years and finally wrote a novel that everyone loved very much.

text.traditional: 我學做蛋糕學了很久，還是做不出讓自己滿意的蛋糕。
text.simplified: 我学做蛋糕学了很久，还是做不出让自己满意的蛋糕。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xué zuò dàngāo xué le hěn jiǔ, háishì zuò bù chū ràng zìjǐ mǎnyì de dàngāo.
text.english: I have learned baking cakes for a long time, but still cannot produce a cake that satisfies myself.

segments.traditional: 了一部令人感動的劇本。

result.traditional: 那位作家終於寫出了一部令人感動的劇本。

result.pinyin: Nà wèi zuòjiā zhōngyú xiě chū le yí bù lìngrén gǎndòng de jùběn.
result.english: That author finally produced a moving script.

repairs.note: 而 is a coordinating conjunction connecting clauses.
再說 introduces an additional reason, not a descriptive summary.
多麼 is an exclamatory degree adverb, not used before noun phrases.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give an exemplar or reference a type of person/thing using 像…這樣子.
grammarPages.explanation: 像…這樣子 points to a specific example or type of person/situation, often followed by a comment or evaluation.
grammarPages.pattern: 像 + Noun / Clause + 這樣子 + Comment

complement.traditional: 這樣子的人很有責任感。
complement.simplified: 这样子的人很有责任感。

items.question: Can 像…這樣子 stand without an example inside?
items.answer: 像…這樣子 frames an example; the example or role must sit between 像 and 這樣子.

right.pinyin: Xiàng tā zhèyàngzi de rén hěn hǎo.
right.english: People like him are very good.

items.question: Does 這樣子 replace ordinary 這樣?
items.answer: 這樣子 sounds more conversational and vivid; both point to a manner or type of person.

right.pinyin: Nǐ bié zhèyàng zuò ba.
right.english: Don't do it like this.

text.traditional: 小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
text.simplified: 小简是一个有爱心、有礼貌的人，像这样子的男人你要好好把握啊！
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yí ge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
text.english: Xiao Jian is caring and polite; a man like this, you should really hold on to him!

text.traditional: 像每天加班到深夜這樣子，身體早晚會吃不消的。
text.simplified: 像每天加班到深夜这样子，身体早晚会吃不消的。
text.pinyin: Xiàng měitiān jiābān dào shēnyè zhèyàngzi, shēntǐ zǎowǎn huì chībùxiāo de.
text.english: Living like this, working overtime late every night, the body won't be able to take it sooner or later.

text.traditional: 像他這樣子有實力又肯努力的演員，一定能成功的。
text.simplified: 像他这样子有实力又肯努力的演员，一定能成功的。
text.pinyin: Xiàng tā zhèyàngzi yǒu shílì yòu kěn nǔlì de yǎnyuán, yídìng néng chénggōng de.
text.english: An actor like this who has talent and is willing to work hard is bound to succeed.

result.english: A young person striving hard like him, everyone admires greatly.

repairs.note: 而 is a coordinating conjunction connecting clauses.
出 follows a verb to indicate bringing a result into existence (V出).
再說 introduces an additional reason, not a descriptive summary.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursuing His Dream

text.traditional: 電影是許多人生活中的休閒娛樂，但是要把一部電影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.simplified: 电影是许多人生活中的休闲娱乐，但是要把一部电影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.english: Movies are leisure entertainment in many people's lives, but making a good movie is by no means an easy task.

text.traditional: 東賢從小就對電影很有興趣，常常夢想自己能成為一位著名的導演。
text.simplified: 东賢从小就对电影很有兴趣，常常梦想自己能成为一位着名的导演。
text.english: Ever since childhood, Dongxian has been very interested in movies, often dreaming of becoming a famous director.

text.traditional: 為了追求這個夢想，東賢高中畢業後就決定到臺灣學習中文和電影製作。
text.simplified: 为了追求这个梦想，东賢高中毕业后就决定到台湾学习中文和电影制作。
text.english: In pursuit of this dream, after graduating from high school Dongxian decided to go to Taiwan to learn Chinese and filmmaking.

text.traditional: 起初，東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定，希望他能留在韓國念商學。
text.simplified: 起初，东賢的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定，希望他能留在韩国念商学。
text.english: Initially, Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future, hoping he would stay in Korea to study business.

text.traditional: 但東賢拿出自己的計畫書，向父母保證自己一定會認真學習、照顧好自己。
text.simplified: 但东賢拿出自己的计画书，向父母保证自己一定会认真学习、照顾好自己。
text.english: However, Dongxian presented his plan and guaranteed to his parents that he would study earnestly and take good care of himself.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣後，東賢一邊在大學念書，一邊在電影劇組實習，生活雖然忙碌但非常充實。
text.simplified: 到了台湾后，东賢一边在大学念书，一边在电影剧组实习，生活虽然忙碌但非常充实。
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian studied at university while interning on film sets; life was busy yet very fulfilling.

text.traditional: 東賢說：「追求夢想就像畫一張美麗的圖畫，只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。」
text.simplified: 东賢说：「追求梦想就像画一张美丽的图画，只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。」
text.english: Dongxian said: 'Pursuing a dream is like drawing a beautiful picture; as long as you work continuously, you will definitely paint a splendid life.'

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use rhetorical questions with 不是…嗎 to confirm or emphasize a known fact.
grammarPages.explanation: This rhetorical pattern asks a question to confirm something the speaker believes is true, or to gently remind the listener.

items.question: Does 不是…嗎 ask a genuine information question?
items.answer: No. 不是…嗎 is a rhetorical question reminding or confirming something obvious to the speaker.

right.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān jǐdiǎn lái de?
right.english: What time did you arrive yesterday?

items.question: Can 不是…嗎 take question words like 什麼 inside?
items.answer: No. Rhetorical 不是…嗎 frames a complete statement to seek agreement; drop question words.

right.pinyin: Zhè bú shì hǎo dōngxi ma?
right.english: Isn't this a great thing?

text.traditional: 你不是早就計畫好要出國了嗎？怎麼現在才請假呢？
text.simplified: 你不是早就计画好要出国了吗？怎么现在才请假呢？
text.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì zǎojiù jìhuà hǎo yào chūguó le ma? Zěnme xiànzài cái qǐngjià ne?
text.english: Didn't you plan to go abroad long ago? Why are you asking for leave only now?

text.traditional: 這家超商不是二十四小時營業的嗎？
text.simplified: 这家超商不是二十四小时营业的吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng bú shì èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè de ma?
text.english: Isn't this convenience store open 24 hours?

text.traditional: 他不是上個月才剛換新工作嗎？
text.simplified: 他不是上个月才刚换新工作吗？
text.pinyin: Tā bú shì shàng ge yuè cái gāng huàn xīn gōngzuò ma?
text.english: Didn't he just change to a new job last month?

items.prompt: Reminding a friend about an arrangement:

segments.traditional: 約好要一起去圖書館[嗎

result.traditional: 我們明天不是約好要一起去圖書館嗎？
result.simplified: 我们明天不是约好要一起去图书馆吗？
result.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān bú shì yuē hǎo yào yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn ma?
result.english: Didn't we arrange to go to the library together tomorrow?

repairs.note: 順便 means "in passing / conveniently", which requires an action done alongside a primary task.
算了 expresses resignation or dropping an idea, which contradicts the sentence context.
一會兒 expresses alternating quick actions (一會兒…一會兒…), not a single statement.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express doing a secondary action on the way using 順便.
grammarPages.explanation: 順便 indicates that an action is done conveniently while doing the primary task, without requiring extra trip or special effort.

items.question: Can 順便 be used for a special, deliberate trip?
items.answer: No. 順便 means 'in passing / on the way' without going out of your way; for a deliberate trip, say 特地 or 專門.

right.pinyin: Wǒ tēdì zuò fēijī qù kàn nǐ.
right.english: I specially flew to visit you.

items.question: Where is 順便 placed in relation to the secondary action?
items.answer: 順便 sits immediately before the secondary verb phrase that you perform on the way.

right.pinyin: Wǒ qù chāoshāng shùnbiàn mǎi niúnǎi.
right.english: I went to the store and conveniently bought milk.

text.traditional: 紀先生下班經過朋友家時，順便把幫朋友買的筆電送去了。
text.simplified: 纪先生下班经过朋友家时，顺便把帮朋友买的笔电送去了。
text.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng xiàbān jīngguò péngyǒu jiā shí, shùnbiàn bǎ bāng péngyǒu mǎi de bǐdiàn sòng qù le.
text.english: When Mr. Ji passed by his friend's house after work, he conveniently dropped off the laptop he bought for him.

text.traditional: 你去便利商店的時候，能不能順便幫我買一杯熱拿鐵？
text.simplified: 你去便利商店的时候，能不能顺便帮我买一杯热拿铁？
text.pinyin: Nǐ qù biànlì shāngdiàn de shíhòu, néng bù néng shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi yì bēi rè nátiě?
text.english: When you go to the convenience store, could you conveniently buy a hot latte for me?

text.traditional: 小龍跟顧客介紹新產品的時候，都會順便說說他自己使用的經驗。
text.simplified: 小龙跟顾客介绍新产品的时候，都会顺便说说他自己使用的经验。
text.pinyin: Xiǎolóng gēn gùkè jièshào xīn chǎnpǐn de shíhòu, dōu huì shùnbiàn shuōshuō tā zìjǐ shǐyòng de jīngyàn.
text.english: When Xiaolong introduces new products to customers, he always shares his own usage experience along the way.

items.prompt: Asking someone for a favor while they are out:

result.traditional: 你經過超商時，請順便幫我拿網購的包裹。
result.simplified: 你经过超商时，请顺便帮我拿网购的包裹。
result.pinyin: Nǐ jīngguò chāoshāng shí, qǐng shùnbiàn bāng wǒ ná wǎnggòu de bāoguǒ.
result.english: When you pass by the convenience store, please conveniently pick up my online parcel.

repairs.note: 不是 forms rhetorical questions (不是…嗎) or negation, not alternating actions.
算了 expresses resignation or dropping an idea, which contradicts the sentence context.
一會兒 expresses alternating quick actions (一會兒…一會兒…), not a single statement.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe two alternating actions or rapidly changing conditions using 一會兒…一會兒….
grammarPages.explanation: This structure describes alternating actions occurring in quick succession, or states changing repeatedly.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一會兒 + Action 1 + 一會兒 + Action 2

items.question: Can 一會兒…一會兒… describe simultaneous actions?
items.answer: No. It describes alternating actions in quick succession; for simultaneous actions, use 一邊…一邊….
items.wrongTraditional: 他一會兒吃飯一會兒看電視。
items.wrongSimplified: 他一会儿吃饭一会儿看电视。

right.traditional: 他一邊吃飯一邊看電視。
right.simplified: 他一边吃饭一边看电视。
right.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chīfàn yìbiān kàn diànshì.
right.english: He is eating while watching television.

items.question: Can 一會兒 be used with a single verb?
items.answer: In this pattern, both parts must repeat (一會兒 A，一會兒 B) to show alternation.

right.traditional: 他今天一會兒哭一會兒笑。
right.simplified: 他今天一会儿哭一会儿笑。
right.pinyin: Tā jīntiān yíhuìr kū yíhuìr xiào.
right.english: Today he cries one moment and laughs the next.

text.traditional: 今天整天下雨，風一會兒大，一會兒小，這樣的天氣出門真麻煩！
text.simplified: 今天整天下雨，风一会儿大，一会儿小，这样的天气出门真麻烦！
text.pinyin: Jīntiān zhěng tiān xiàyǔ, fēng yìhuǐr dà, yìhuǐr xiǎo, zhèyàng de tiānqì chūmén zhēn máfan!
text.english: It rained all day today; the wind was strong one moment and weak the next. Going out in such weather is really troublesome!

text.traditional: 店員一會兒幫客人微波便當，一會兒忙著結帳，一刻都停不下來。
text.simplified: 店员一会儿帮客人微波便当，一会儿忙着结帐，一刻都停不下来。
text.pinyin: Diànyuán yìhuǐr bāng kèrén wēibō biàndāng, yìhuǐr máng zhe jiézhàng, yí kè dōu tíng bù xiàlái.
text.english: The clerk microwaved bento for customers one moment, and bustled checking out the next, unable to stop for a second.

text.traditional: 妹妹做功課的時候很不專心，一會兒吃零食，一會兒玩手機。
text.simplified: 妹妹做功课的时候很不专心，一会儿吃零食，一会儿玩手机。
text.pinyin: Mèimei zuò gōngkè de shíhòu hěn bù zhuānxīn, yìhuǐr chī língshí, yìhuǐr wán shǒujī.
text.english: When my younger sister did homework she was very unfocused, eating snacks one minute and playing on her phone the next.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 山上的天氣變化真快，剛才還出大太陽，現在___下起雨來了。

result.traditional: 春天常常一會兒出太陽，一會兒刮大風。
result.simplified: 春天常常一会儿出太阳，一会儿刮大风。
result.pinyin: Chūntiān chángcháng yìhuǐr chū tàiyáng, yìhuǐr guā dàfēng.
result.english: In spring, it is sunny one moment, and windy the next.

repairs.note: 順便 means "in passing / conveniently", which requires an action done alongside a primary task.
算了 expresses resignation or dropping an idea, which contradicts the sentence context.
不是 forms rhetorical questions (不是…嗎) or negation, not alternating actions.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give up a plan or accept a compromised situation using 算了.
grammarPages.explanation: 算了 indicates dropping a plan or settling for an alternative when facing difficulties or fatigue.

items.question: Can 算了 mean 'calculated correctly'?
items.answer: As an idiom, 算了 means 'forget it / let it drop'; to calculate, use 算好了.

right.pinyin: Zhè dào shùxué tí wǒ suàn hǎo le.
right.english: I have calculated this math problem.

items.question: Can 算了 precede a noun directly?
items.answer: 算了 is a predicate exclamation or clause-final marker; it never acts as a noun modifier.

right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suànle ba.
right.english: Let's just drop this matter.

text.traditional: 這幾天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮飯，我想就去便利商店買算了。
text.simplified: 这几天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮饭，我想就去便利商店买算了。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān gōngzuò máng sǐ le, wǎnshàng bù xiǎng zhǔfàn, wǒ xiǎng jiù qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi suàn le.
text.english: Work has been crazy busy these past few days and I don't want to cook dinner; I think I'll just buy from the convenience store.

text.traditional: 外面雨下得這麼大，我看今天的爬山行程就算了吧。
text.simplified: 外面雨下得这么大，我看今天的爬山行程就算了吧。
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǔ xià de zhème dà, wǒ kàn jīntiān de páshān xíngchéng jiù suàn le ba.
text.english: It is raining so hard outside; I think we might as well cancel today's hiking itinerary.

text.traditional: 修這輛老舊的機車要花幾萬元，我看買台新的算了。
text.simplified: 修这辆老旧的机车要花几万元，我看买台新的算了。
text.pinyin: Xiū zhè liàng lǎojiù de jīchē yào huā jǐ wàn yuán, wǒ kàn mǎi tái xīn de suàn le.
text.english: Fixing this old scooter costs tens of thousands; I think buying a new one is better.

result.traditional: 排隊的人實在太多了，我們去別家吃算了吧。
result.simplified: 排队的人实在太多了，我们去别家吃算了吧。
result.pinyin: Páiduì de rén shízài tài duō le, wǒmen qù bié jiā chī suàn le ba.
result.english: There are really too many people lining up; let's just go eat elsewhere.

repairs.note: 順便 means "in passing / conveniently", which requires an action done alongside a primary task.

dialogue.title: 對話 · Dialogue
dialogue.setting: 在便利商店 · At the convenience store

text.traditional: 朋子，臺灣的便利商店真的太神奇了！不僅能買東西，還能繳水電費、寄包裹，甚至還能買高鐵票！
text.simplified: 朋子，台湾的便利商店真的太神奇了！不仅能买东西，还能缴水电费、寄包裹，甚至还能买高铁票！
text.english: Tomoko, Taiwan's convenience stores are really amazing! Not only can you buy things, but you can also pay utility bills, send packages, and even buy high-speed rail tickets!

text.traditional: 是啊，臺灣的超商密度可以說是世界第一呢。走幾步路就有一家，肚子餓了隨時都能買到熱騰騰的便當。
text.simplified: 是啊，台湾的超商密度可以说是世界第一呢。走几步路就有一家，肚子饿了随时都能买到热騰騰的便当。
text.english: Yes, Taiwan's convenience store density is practically number one in the world. There's one every few steps, and when you are hungry you can buy piping hot bento boxes anytime.

text.traditional: 我剛來臺灣的時候，看到店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒幫客人微波便當，一會兒又幫忙結帳，真是嚇了一跳！
text.simplified: 我刚来台湾的时候，看到店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿帮客人微波便当，一会儿又帮忙结帐，真是吓了一跳！
text.english: When I first came to Taiwan, seeing the clerk brewing coffee one moment, microwaving bento for customers the next, and helping check out right after, I was really astonished!

text.traditional: 臺灣的超商店員樣樣精通，工作非常辛苦。
text.simplified: 台湾的超商店员样样精通，工作非常辛苦。
text.english: Taiwan's convenience store clerks master everything; their work is very hardworking.

text.traditional: 你今天也是來便利商店繳費的嗎？
text.simplified: 你今天也是来便利商店缴费的吗？
text.english: Did you come to the convenience store to pay bills today too?

text.traditional: 不是，我是順便來拿網購的包裹，順便買杯冰美式咖啡。
text.simplified: 不是，我是顺便来拿网购的包裹，顺便买杯冰美式咖啡。
text.english: No, I came by the way to pick up an online shopping parcel, and pick up an iced Americano while I'm at it.

text.traditional: 我本來想回家煮晚餐，但今天加班太累了，我看就算了吧，在超商買個便當吃算了。
text.simplified: 我本来想回家煮晚餐，但今天加班太累了，我看就算了吧，在超商买个便当吃算了。
text.english: I originally wanted to go home and cook dinner, but I worked overtime and was too tired today. I guess never mind, I might as well just buy a bento at the convenience store.

text.traditional: 哈哈，偶爾吃一次沒關係啦。走，我們一起進去吹冷氣選便當！

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize stubbornness or an unyielding result using 就是.
grammarPages.explanation: 就是 here acts as an emphatic adverb indicating that something simply happens or fails despite repeated efforts.

items.question: Does emphatic 就是 mean 'A equals B'?
items.answer: Emphatic 就是 expresses stubborn insistence or refusal ('simply won't'); not the equational 'is'.

right.pinyin: Nà běn shū jiùshì zìdiǎn.
right.english: That book is indeed a dictionary.

items.question: Where does emphatic 就是 sit with negation 不?
items.answer: 就是 sits before 不 (就是不聽, 就是不去), emphasizing obstinate refusal.

right.pinyin: Tā jiùshì bú qù.
right.english: He simply refuses to go.

text.traditional: 這個門我開了半天就是打不開，你過來看看。
text.simplified: 这个门我开了半天就是打不开，你过来看看。
text.pinyin: Zhège mén wǒ kāi le bàntiān jiùshì dǎ bù kāi, nǐ guòlái kànkan.
text.english: I tried to open this door for ages, but it just won't open; come and take a look.

text.english: The doctor advised him to drink less, but he simply refused to drop this bad habit.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express a result achieved through a process or time period using 經過.
grammarPages.explanation: 經過 indicates undergoing a certain process, experience, or period of time that leads to an outcome.

items.question: Can 經過 mean passing by a physical location?
items.answer: Yes, as a verb it means passing by; as a preposition here, it means 'through the process of'.

right.traditional: 經過超商時我想買東西。
right.simplified: 经过超商时我想买东西。
right.pinyin: Jīngguò chāoshāng shí wǒ xiǎng mǎi dōngxi.
right.english: When passing by the store, I wanted to buy something.

items.question: Can 經過 be followed immediately by an adjective without a process?
items.answer: 經過 introduces an experience or process, not an adjective attribute.

right.pinyin: Jīngguò nǔlì tā chénggōng le.
right.english: Through hard work, he succeeded.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express the method or instrument used to achieve an objective using 用…來….

items.question: Can 來 be omitted in the 用…來… pattern?
items.answer: 來 links the instrument/means to the purpose; omitting it weakens the purposive connection.

right.pinyin: Tā yòng zhè zhī bǐ lái xiězì.
right.english: He uses this pen to write.

items.question: Can the purpose in 來 precede the tool in 用?
items.answer: No. The order is always Tool/Means first (用 X), then Purpose second (來 Y).

right.pinyin: Tā yòng bǐ lái xiězì.
right.english: He uses a pen to write.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express testing something through an action using 試+V.
grammarPages.explanation: 試 placed before a verb indicates attempting or testing something out before making a commitment.

items.question: Can 試+V take any multi-syllable verb phrase?
items.answer: 試+V typically pairs with monosyllabic action verbs of testing (試穿, 試開, 試吃, 試做).

right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shìchuān zhè jiàn yīfu.
right.english: I would like to try on these clothes.

items.question: Does 試+V replace 試試看?
items.answer: 試+V forms a compound testing action (試喝, 試開); 試試看 is placed after a verb phrase.

right.pinyin: Nǐ shìchī kànkan ba.
right.english: Try a taste and see.

text.traditional: 買床的時候一定要試躺，覺得舒服再買。
text.simplified: 买床的时候一定要试躺，觉得舒服再买。
text.pinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhòu yídìng yào shìtǎng, juéde shūfu zài mǎi.
text.english: When buying a bed, you must definitely try lying on it, and only buy after feeling comfortable.

text.traditional: 那家超商提供新口味的飲料給客人免費試喝，喝過的人都說好喝。
text.simplified: 那家超商提供新口味的饮料给客人免费试喝，喝过的人都说好喝。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshāng tígōng xīn kǒuwèi de yǐnliào gěi kèrén miǎnfèi shìhē, hē guò de rén dōu shuō hǎohē.
text.english: That convenience store provides new flavor drinks for customers to taste test for free; everyone who tried praised it.

text.traditional: 這雙皮鞋很特別，你要不要先試穿看看？
text.simplified: 这双皮鞋很特别，你要不要先试穿看看？
text.pinyin: Zhè shuāng píxié hěn tèbié, nǐ yào bú yào xiān shìchuān kànkan?
text.english: This pair of leather shoes is very special; do you want to try wearing them first?

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Compare two choices and recommend the superior alternative using 不如.
grammarPages.explanation: 不如 indicates that option B is preferable or superior to option A (often paired with 與其…不如…).
grammarPages.pattern: Option A + 不如 + Option B

items.question: In recommendations, which option does 不如 favor?
items.answer: 不如 precedes the better choice: 'A 不如 B' means B is better than A.
items.wrongTraditional: 今天下雨，去爬山不如在家看書。
items.wrongSimplified: 今天下雨，去爬山不如在家看书。

right.traditional: 今天下雨，不如在家看書。
right.simplified: 今天下雨，不如在家看书。
right.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàyǔ, bùrú zài jiā kànshū.
right.english: It's raining today; it would be better to read at home.

items.question: Can 不如 be used without a preceding situation?
items.answer: 不如 usually introduces a sensible alternative given the current circumstance.

right.pinyin: Wǒmen bùrú xiān chīfàn ba.
right.english: We might as well eat first.

text.traditional: 你那輛車不常開又舊得很，不如賣掉吧！

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Introduce a sole reservation or exception using 就是.
grammarPages.explanation: When stating that everything is satisfactory or acceptable with one exception, 就是 introduces that sole reservation.

items.question: Does 就是 (except) indicate insistence?
items.answer: No. Here 就是 means 'the only drawback is... / it's just that', introducing a minor reservation.
items.wrongTraditional: 這件衣服很貴，就是很好。

right.english: These clothes are great; it's just that they're a bit expensive.

items.question: Where does reservation 就是 sit in the discourse?
items.answer: Reservation 就是 sits in the second clause, after the general positive evaluation.

items.wrongSimplified: 就是有点贵，这家店很好吃。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Persuade someone to cease an action using 別再…了.
grammarPages.explanation: 別再…了 expresses an urgent or earnest dissuasion, asking the listener to stop an ongoing or repeated action.

items.question: Can 別再…了 be used if the action hasn't started?
items.answer: No. 別再 implies the action was already happening and must now cease; use 別 for fresh warnings.

right.pinyin: Míngtiān kǎoshì, nǐ bié chídào le.
right.english: Tomorrow is the exam, don't be late.

items.question: Can 了 be dropped in 別再…了?
items.answer: 了 signals the change of state (stopping now) and is standard in this pattern.

right.pinyin: Nǐ bié zài shuō le.
right.english: Don't say any more.

text.traditional: 孩子對媽媽說：您別再幫我洗衣服了！我已經長大，自己會洗了。

text.english: The child said to mother: Don't wash clothes for me any longer! I have grown up and can wash them myself.

text.simplified: 是挺好看的，但买衣服一定要先试穿，试穿看看合不合身再决定。

text.simplified: 你说得对。那我先进去试穿这件浅蓝色的。

text.traditional: 放心吧，樓上有幾個專櫃不僅質料柔軟，價格也很實在。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect two coordinated positive or negative attributes using 不僅…也/還….
grammarPages.explanation: 不僅…也/還… coordinates two clauses or predicates, introducing supplementary qualities with progressive emphasis.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不僅 + Predicate 1 + 也 / 還 + Predicate 2

items.question: Can 不僅 be paired with 但是?
items.answer: No. 不僅 is an additive conjunction; it pairs with 也 or 還, never with contrastive 但是.

right.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn cōngmíng yě hěn qínláo.
right.english: He is not only smart but also diligent.

items.question: How does 不僅 differ from 不但?
items.answer: 不僅 and 不但 share identical grammar; 不僅 has a more refined, formal tone.

right.traditional: 我不僅去過那裡也喜歡那裡。
right.simplified: 我不仅去过那里也喜欢那里。
right.pinyin: Wǒ bùjǐn qùguo nàlǐ yě xǐhuan nàlǐ.
right.english: I have not only been there, but also like it there.

text.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真負責，所以同事都很喜歡他。
text.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真负责，所以同事都很喜欢他。
text.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn fùzé, suǒyǐ tóngshì dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
text.english: Mr. Xie not only has an upbeat personality, but is also very conscientious at work, so coworkers all like him.

text.traditional: 這棟大樓不僅防震設計優良，通風與採光也十分理想。
text.simplified: 这栋大楼不仅防震设计优良，通风与采光也十分理想。
text.pinyin: Zhè dòng dàlóu bùjǐn fángzhèn shèjì yōuliáng, tōngfēng yǔ cǎiguāng yě shífēn lǐxiǎng.
text.english: This building not only has excellent earthquake-resistant design, but ventilation and lighting are also very ideal.

text.traditional: 現代消費者不僅看重商品價格，還特別講究環保與健康。
text.simplified: 现代消费者不仅看重商品价格，还特别讲究环保与健康。
text.pinyin: Xiàndài xiāofèizhě bùjǐn kànzhòng shāngpǐn jiàgé, hái tèbié jiǎngjiū huánbǎo yǔ jiànkāng.
text.english: Modern consumers not only care about product price, but also emphasize environmental friendliness and health.

result.english: This smart watch not only can measure heartbeat, but also possesses positioning functionality.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express progressive increase with each iteration using 一+Classifier+比+一+Classifier.
grammarPages.explanation: Repeating the classifier in the pattern '一 M 比 一 M + Adjective' denotes progressive increase over successive occurrences.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一 M 比 一 M + Adjective / Predicate

items.question: Can 一次比一次 be followed by an unchanged state?
items.answer: No. It requires a scalar adjective showing progressive increase (好, 難, 貴).
items.wrongTraditional: 他的成績一次比一次一樣。
items.wrongSimplified: 他的成绩一次比一次一样。

right.traditional: 他的成績一次比一次好。
right.simplified: 他的成绩一次比一次好。
right.pinyin: Tā de chéngjī yí cì bǐ yí cì hǎo.
right.english: His grades are better each time.

items.question: Can other measure words replace 次 in this pattern?
items.answer: Yes! You can say 一年比一年 (year by year) or 一天比一天 (day by day).

right.pinyin: Tiānqì yì tiān bǐ yì tiān lěng.
right.english: The weather gets colder day by day.

text.traditional: 這個學期王小明很用功，考試的成績也一次比一次進步了。
text.simplified: 这个学期王小明很用功，考试的成绩也一次比一次进步了。
text.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī Wáng Xiǎomíng hěn yònggōng, kǎoshì de chéngjī yě yí cì bǐ yí cì jìnbù le.
text.english: Wang Xiaoming studied very hard this semester, and his test scores improved with each exam.

text.traditional: 這個地區因為工廠越來越多的關係，空氣一年比一年差了。
text.simplified: 这个地区因为工厂越来越多的关系，空气一年比一年差了。
text.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō de guānxi, kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
text.english: Because there are more and more factories in this region, the air quality has worsened year by year.

text.traditional: 他的廚藝在不斷練習之下，做出來的菜餚一次比一次可口。
text.simplified: 他的厨艺在不断练习之下，做出来的菜餚一次比一次可口。
text.pinyin: Tā de chúyì zài búduàn liànxí zhī xià, zuò chūlái de càiyáo yí cì bǐ yí cì kěkǒu.
text.english: Under continuous practice of culinary skills, the dishes he prepares become more delicious every time.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 貨比三家不吃虧 · Shopping Around to Get the Best Deal

text.traditional: 在現代消費社會中，每個人都希望能「買得開心、用得放心」。
text.simplified: 在现代消费社会中，每个人都希望能「买得开心、用得放心」。
text.english: In modern consumer society, everyone hopes to 'buy with joy and use with peace of mind.'

text.traditional: 俗話說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是在購買貴重物品前，多比較幾家商店的價格與品質，才不會吃虧上當。
text.simplified: 俗话说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是在购买贵重物品前，多比较几家商店的价格与品质，才不会吃亏上当。
text.english: As the proverb says, 'Shop around and you won't suffer a loss,' meaning before purchasing expensive items, compare prices and quality across several stores so you won't get cheated.

text.traditional: 以前人們為了比價，得跑好幾家實體店鋪，費時又費力。
text.simplified: 以前人们为了比价，得跑好几家实体店鋪，费时又费力。
text.english: In the past, to compare prices people had to run around several physical shops, which was time-consuming and laborious.

text.traditional: 現在網路科技發達，大家不僅能透過比價網站輕鬆查詢價格，還能參考其他消費者的評價。
text.simplified: 现在网路科技发达，大家不仅能透过比价网站轻松查詢价格，还能参考其他消费者的评价。
text.english: Now with advanced internet technology, people not only can easily query prices via price-comparison sites, but also consult reviews from other consumers.

text.traditional: 消費者變得一次比一次聰明，商家也一年比一年更注重產品質量與售後服務。
text.simplified: 消费者变得一次比一次聪明，商家也一年比一年更注重产品质量与售后服务。
text.english: Consumers become smarter each time, and businesses focus more on product quality and customer service year after year.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Exclaim admiration or shock at a vivid quality using 好+Vs+的+N啊.
grammarPages.explanation: This exclamatory phrase expresses emotional exclamation regarding an outstanding or extreme attribute of a noun.
grammarPages.pattern: 好 + Adjective + 的 + Noun + 啊！

items.question: Can 好+Vs+的+N啊 be used as a plain question?
items.answer: No. It is purely an exclamatory praise pattern, not an inquiry.

right.pinyin: Zhè xīguā tián bù tián?
right.english: Is this watermelon sweet?

items.question: Can 的 be omitted before the noun?
items.answer: 的 is required to link the modified stative verb phrase to the head noun.

right.pinyin: Hǎo tián de xīguā a!
right.english: What a sweet watermelon!

text.traditional: 你看，好精緻的油飯和紅蛋啊！
text.simplified: 你看，好精緻的油饭和红蛋啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, hǎo jīngzhì de yóufàn hé hóngdàn a!
text.english: Look, what exquisite oily rice and red eggs!

text.traditional: 好酸的檸檬汁啊！你忘了加糖嗎？
text.simplified: 好酸的柠檬汁啊！你忘了加糖吗？
text.pinyin: Hǎo suān de níngméngzhī a! Nǐ wàng le jiā táng ma?
text.english: What sour lemon juice! Did you forget to add sugar?

text.traditional: 今天晚上好美麗的夜景啊！從這裡看臺北真漂亮。
text.simplified: 今天晚上好美丽的夜景啊！从这里看台北真漂亮。

text.english: What a beautiful night view tonight! Looking at Taipei from here is truly gorgeous.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize doing an action oneself rather than delegating it using 親自.
grammarPages.explanation: 親自 emphasizes that a subject performs an action directly in person, highlighting respect, sincerity, or importance.

items.question: How does 親自 differ from 自己?
items.answer: 親自 emphasizes in-person physical presence and sincerity; 自己 means by oneself without help.

right.pinyin: Tā zìjǐ chī le yì wǎn fàn.
right.english: He ate a bowl of rice by himself.

items.question: Where does 親自 sit in the sentence?
items.answer: 親自 is an adverb and must precede the verb phrase it modifies.

right.pinyin: Tā qīnzì lái jiē wǒ.
right.english: He came to pick me up in person.

text.traditional: 我早上出門時忘了帶手機，沒想到兒子親自拿到公司給我。
text.simplified: 我早上出门时忘了带手机，没想到儿子亲自拿到公司给我。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshàng chūmén shí wàng le dài shǒujī, méi xiǎngdào érzi qīnzì ná dào gōngsī gěi wǒ.
text.english: I forgot my phone when leaving this morning; unexpectedly my son brought it to the company for me in person.

text.traditional: 為了表示誠意，經理決定親自拜訪重要的合作廠商。
text.simplified: 为了表示诚意，经理决定亲自拜访重要的合作厂商。
text.pinyin: Wèile biǎoshì chéngyì, jīnglǐ juédìng qīnzì bàifǎng zhòngyào de hézuò chǎngshāng.
text.english: To demonstrate sincerity, the manager decided to visit the important partnering manufacturer in person.

text.traditional: 這件木雕藝術品是那位老師傅親手親自雕刻完成的。
text.simplified: 这件木雕艺术品是那位老师傅亲手亲自雕刻完成的。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn mùdiāo yìshùpǐn shì nà wèi lǎoshīfù qīnshǒu qīnzì diāokè wánchéng de.
text.english: This woodcarving art piece was carved and completed personally by that master craftsman.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express repetitive or back-and-forth action using V來V去.
grammarPages.explanation: This structure describes an action performed repeatedly in various directions or manners, often without conclusive resolution.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 來 + Verb + 去

items.question: Can multi-syllable verbs fit V來V去?
items.answer: No. The verb in V來V去 must be monosyllabic (走來走去, 想來想去, 看了又看).

right.pinyin: Tā xiǎng lái xiǎng qù.
right.english: He pondered back and forth.

items.question: Can V來V去 describe a completed single trip?
items.answer: No. V來V去 implies aimless or repeated back-and-forth action without resolution.

right.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān lǐ zǒu lái zǒu qù.
right.english: He paced back and forth in the room.

text.traditional: 我在禮品店找來找去，最後終於挑到滿意的禮物。
text.simplified: 我在礼品店找来找去，最后终于挑到满意的礼物。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài lǐpǐndiàn zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zuìhòu zhōngyú tiāo dào mǎnyì de lǐwù.
text.english: I searched back and forth in the gift store, and finally picked out a satisfying gift.

text.traditional: 這幾個月我不斷地找工作，找來找去，還是找不到滿意的薪水。
text.simplified: 这几个月我不断地找工作，找来找去，还是找不到满意的薪水。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè wǒ búduàn de zhǎo gōngzuò, zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, háishì zhǎo bù dào mǎnyì de xīnshuǐ.
text.english: I searched continuously for jobs these months; searching back and forth, I still can't find a satisfying salary.

items.question: How does 終於 differ from 最後?

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe continuous, unstoppable actions using V個不停.

items.question: Can multi-syllable verbs take 個不停?
items.answer: Typically monosyllabic verbs of expressive action take 個不停 (哭個不停, 笑個不停, 說個不停).

items.question: Can 個 be omitted in V個不停?

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a moderate state that avoids extremes using 不A不B.
grammarPages.explanation: This four-character frame pairs contrasting or related antonym adjectives to indicate a moderate, balanced, or neutral state.

items.question: Can 不A不B take random antonyms?
items.answer: It uses established coordinate antonym pairs (不冷不熱, 不大不小, 不長不短) to express ideal moderation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an exclusive situation where only one or two things exist using 除了…就是….
grammarPages.explanation: 除了 A 就是 B expresses that apart from A, there is only B; indicating an exclusive, monotonous, or narrow situation.
grammarPages.pattern: 除了 + Category A + 就是 + Category B

items.question: How does 除了…就是… differ from 除了…還有…?
items.answer: 除了…就是… expresses exclusive limitation (nothing else except this); 除了…還有… is open addition.
items.wrongTraditional: 桌上除了書就是筆還有水。
items.wrongSimplified: 桌上除了书就是笔还有水。

items.question: Can 就是 be replaced by 也是 in this pattern?
items.answer: No. 就是 signals the exclusive focus ('only X and nothing else'); 也是 breaks the pattern.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: State an either-or dichotomy using 不是…就是….
grammarPages.explanation: 不是 A 就是 B indicates that an outcome or situation invariably falls into one of two options.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不是 + Option A + 就是 + Option B

items.question: Does 不是…就是… allow a third alternative?
items.answer: No. 不是 A 就是 B indicates an either/or dilemma where it is invariably one of the two.
items.wrongTraditional: 他不是看書就是睡覺或者是運動。
items.wrongSimplified: 他不是看书就是睡觉或者是运动。

items.question: Can 不是…就是… mean both are true together?
items.answer: No. For both qualities, use 不但…而且… or 不僅…也….

text.traditional: 親愛的以晴，收到妳寄來的婚禮照片，看到妳美麗幸福的模樣，真替妳高興！
text.simplified: 亲爱的以晴，收到你寄来的婚礼照片，看到你美丽幸福的模样，真替你高兴！
text.english: Dear Yiqing, receiving the wedding photos you sent and seeing your beautiful, happy appearance, I am so joyful for you!

text.traditional: 可惜因為我剛生完雙胞胎，正在坐月子，沒辦法親自飛到美國參加妳的婚禮。
text.simplified: 可惜因为我刚生完双胞胎，正在坐月子，没办法亲自飞到美国参加你的婚礼。
text.english: Unfortunately, because I just gave birth to twins and am doing postpartum confinement, I couldn't fly to America in person to attend your wedding.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，女人生產後都要坐月子一個月，每天吃麻油雞調養身體，也不能吹風。
text.simplified: 在台湾，女人生产后都要坐月子一个月，每天吃麻油鸡调养身体，也不能吹风。
text.english: In Taiwan, after giving birth women rest in confinement for a month, eating sesame oil chicken daily to nurse the body, and cannot catch drafts.

text.traditional: 這一個月裡，兩個寶寶整天哭個不停，吵著要喝奶，忙得我和先生連睡覺的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 这一个月里，两个宝宝整天哭个不停，吵着要喝奶，忙得我和先生连睡觉的时间都没有。
text.english: During this month, the two babies cried incessantly all day, clamoring for milk, keeping my husband and me so busy that we didn't even have sleep time.

text.traditional: 今天孩子終於滿月了，家裡除了前來祝賀的親戚朋友以外，就是送給客人的油飯和蛋糕。
text.simplified: 今天孩子终于满月了，家里除了前来祝贺的亲戚朋友以外，就是送给客人的油饭和蛋糕。
text.english: Today the children finally completed their full month; in the house, besides visiting relatives and friends, there is only oily rice and cake for guests.

text.traditional: 雖然照顧雙胞胎的生活不是餵奶就是換尿布，但看著寶寶一天天長大，心裡感到無比的幸福。
text.simplified: 虽然照顾双胞胎的生活不是喂奶就是换尿布，但看着宝宝一天天长大，心里感到无比的幸福。
text.english: Although caring for twins means either feeding or diaper-changing, watching the babies grow day by day brings boundless happiness to the heart.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: In Case / If by Any Chance
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Prepare for unexpected contingencies or emergencies using 萬一.
grammarPages.explanation: 萬一 indicates an unforeseen possibility or contingency (usually an unfavorable situation), emphasizing precautions or countermeasures.

items.question: Does 萬一 express high or low probability?
items.answer: 萬一 indicates an unforeseen, low-probability contingency (often unfavorable), requiring preparation.

right.traditional: 明天萬一下雨就帶雨傘吧。
right.simplified: 明天万一下雨就带雨伞吧。
right.pinyin: Míngtiān wànyī xiàyǔ jiù dài yǔsǎn ba.
right.english: In case it rains tomorrow, bring an umbrella.

items.question: Can 萬一 stand after the consequence?
items.answer: 萬一 introduces the contingency clause first, followed by the countermeasure.

right.pinyin: Wànyī xiàyǔ, jiù dài yǔsǎn ba.
right.english: If by chance it rains, take an umbrella.

text.traditional: 出國旅遊前最好先買個旅遊平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外，就不必擔心醫藥費了。
text.simplified: 出国旅游前最好先买个旅游平安保险，万一发生什么意外，就不必担心医药费了。
text.pinyin: Chūguó lǚyóu qián zuì hǎo xiān mǎi ge lǚyóu píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài, jiù búbì dānxīn yīyàofèi le.
text.english: Before traveling abroad you had best buy travel safety insurance; in case any accident happens, you won't need to worry about medical costs.

text.traditional: 我家裡平時都準備了一些蠟燭、電池什麼的，萬一停電了，才不會手忙腳亂。
text.simplified: 我家里平时都准备了一些蜡烛、电池什么的，万一停电了，才不会手忙脚乱。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lǐ píngshí dōu zhǔnbèi le yìxiē làzhú, diànchí shénme de, wànyī tíngdiàn le, cái bú huì shǒumángjiǎoluàn.
text.english: My family usually prepares candles, batteries and such; in case of a blackout, we won't panic.

words.english: candle (M: 根 gēn, 枝 zhī)

text.traditional: 出門前記得把門窗關好，萬一下起暴雨，雨水才不會飄進客廳。
text.simplified: 出门前记得把门窗关好，万一下起暴雨，雨水才不会飄进客厅。
text.pinyin: Chūmén qián jìde bǎ ménchuāng guān hǎo, wànyī xià qǐ bàoyǔ, yǔshuǐ cái bú huì piāo jìn kètīng.
text.english: Remember to close doors and windows before going out; in case it starts pouring, rain won't blow into the living room.

result.english: It's best to put a lightweight raincoat in your backpack, in case you encounter an afternoon thunderstorm so you won't get soaked.

repairs.note: 一連 indicates continuous duration across units of time.
以為 expresses a mistaken belief or assumption.
結果 introduces an outcome or unintended consequence.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express actions or states occurring uninterrupted in sequence using 一連.
grammarPages.explanation: 一連 indicates that an action, event, or condition persists continuously over a succession of days, times, or iterations without break.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一連 + Duration / Frequency + Action

complement.traditional: 說了好幾個難懂的句子。
complement.simplified: 说了好几个难懂的句子。

items.question: Can 一連 be used without a number or time quantifier?
items.answer: No. 一連 requires an explicit number of days, weeks, or times (一連三天, 一連五次).

right.pinyin: Tā yìlián kàn le sān tiān diànshì.
right.english: He watched TV for three days in a row.

items.question: How does 一連 differ from 一直?
items.answer: 一直 emphasizes unbroken state without counting; 一連 stresses unbroken count of units.
items.wrongTraditional: 我一連住在這裡很多年。
items.wrongSimplified: 我一连住在这里很多年。

right.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí zhù zài zhèlǐ.
right.english: I have always lived here.

text.traditional: 他一連說了好幾個我聽不懂的專業術語，他說的到底是什麼意思呢？
text.simplified: 他一连说了好几个我听不懂的专业术语，他说的到底是什么意思呢？
text.pinyin: Tā yìlián shuō le hǎo jǐ ge wǒ tīng bù dǒng de zhuānyè shùyǔ, tā shuō de dàodǐ shì shénme yìsi ne?
text.english: He spoke several technical terms in a row that I couldn't understand; what on earth did he mean?

text.traditional: 我最近忙著趕專案進度，已經一連三個週末都加班了。
text.simplified: 我最近忙着赶专案进度，已经一连三个周末都加班了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn máng zhe gǎn zhuān'àn jìndù, yǐjīng yìlián sān ge zhōumò dōu jiābān le.
text.english: Recently I've been busy rushing project progress, and have worked overtime for three weekends in a row.

text.traditional: 連續下了好幾天的雨，這條河流的水位一連上漲了三公尺。
text.simplified: 连续下了好几天的雨，这条河流的水位一连上涨了三公尺。
text.pinyin: Liánxù xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de yǔ, zhè tiáo héliú de shuǐwèi yìlián shàngzhǎng le sān gōngchǐ.
text.english: It rained continuously for several days, and the water level of this river rose three meters in a row.

result.simplified: 台北的冬天常常陰雨綿綿，一连两周都见不到阳光。

result.english: Taipei's winter is often overcast and drizzly, with no sunshine seen for two weeks in a row.

repairs.note: 萬一 introduces an unfavorable low-probability contingency.
以為 expresses a mistaken belief or assumption.
也好 expresses supportive agreement with a suggestion.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Contrast an initial mistaken assumption with unexpected reality using 以為…沒想到….
grammarPages.explanation: 以為 introduces an assumption that turns out to be contrary to reality, while 沒想到 introduces the surprising factual outcome.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 以為 + Expectation + 沒想到 + Reality

complement.traditional: 沒想到他們連嚐都不肯。
complement.simplified: 没想到他们连尝都不肯。

items.question: Can 以為 be used when the belief was correct?
items.answer: 以為 strongly implies the assumption was mistaken; use 認為 for holding a correct or neutral view.
items.wrongTraditional: 我以為他是台灣人，結果他真的是台灣人。
items.wrongSimplified: 我以为他是台湾人，结果他真的是台湾人。

right.traditional: 我以為他是台灣人，沒想到他是日本人。
right.simplified: 我以为他是台湾人，没想到他是日本人。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā shì Táiwān rén, méi xiǎngdào tā shì Rìběn rén.
right.english: I thought he was Taiwanese; unexpectedly, he is Japanese.

items.question: Can 沒想到 precede the mistaken assumption?
items.answer: No. 以為 introduces the mistaken thought first, then 沒想到 reveals the surprise fact.
items.wrongTraditional: 沒想到他是日本人我以為。
items.wrongSimplified: 没想到他是日本人我以为。

right.traditional: 我以為很簡單，沒想到這麼難。
right.simplified: 我以为很简单，没想到这么难。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi hěn jiǎndān, méi xiǎngdào zhème nán.
right.english: I thought it was simple, unexpectedly it's so difficult.

text.traditional: 我以為東部的情況會好一些，沒想到這次颱風在東部登陸，災情相當嚴重。
text.simplified: 我以为东部的情况会好一些，没想到这次台风在东部登陆，灾情相当严重。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi dōngbù de qíngkuàng huì hǎo yìxiē, méi xiǎngdào zhè cì táifēng zài dōngbù dēnglù, zāiqíng xiāngdāng yánzhòng.
text.english: I thought eastern Taiwan's situation would be better; unexpectedly this typhoon made landfall in the east, causing severe damage.

text.traditional: 王媽媽以為這道新菜孩子們一定搶著吃，沒想到他們連嚐都不肯嚐。
text.simplified: 王妈妈以为这道新菜孩子们一定抢着吃，没想到他们连尝都不肯尝。
text.pinyin: Wáng māma yǐwéi zhè dào xīn cài háizi men yídìng qiǎng zhe chī, méi xiǎngdào tāmen lián cháng dōu bù kěn cháng.
text.english: Mother Wang thought the children would vie to eat this new dish, but unexpectedly they refused to even taste it.

text.traditional: 我以為中文文法很難學，沒想到掌握了規律之後，越學越有成就感。
text.simplified: 我以为中文文法很难学，没想到掌握了规律之后，越学越有成就感。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi zhōngwén wénfǎ hěn nán xué, méi xiǎngdào zhǎowò le guīlǜ zhīhòu, yuè xué yuè yǒu chéngjiùgǎn.
text.english: I thought Chinese grammar would be very difficult to learn; unexpectedly after grasping the patterns, the more I study the more rewarding it feels.

result.english: I thought I messed up this final exam; unexpectedly I actually scored the highest mark!

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Might As Well / That Works Too
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Accept or endorse a practical proposal using 也好.
grammarPages.explanation: 也好 placed at the end of a clause expresses approval or resignation toward a proposal, indicating that it is a sensible or beneficial course of action.

items.question: Where does clause-final 也好 sit?
items.answer: 也好 stands at the end of the proposed clause, conveying supportive approval.

right.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān qù yě hǎo.
right.english: It works well if we go tomorrow.

items.question: Does 也好 indicate strong preference or pleasant acceptance?
items.answer: 也好 indicates pragmatic agreement or acceptance of an alternative, not the sole best choice.
items.wrongTraditional: 我最喜歡這件，也好買它。
items.wrongSimplified: 我最喜欢这件，也好买它。

right.traditional: 要是沒時間，買現成的也好。
right.simplified: 要是没时间，买现成的也好。
right.pinyin: Yàoshi méi shíjiān, mǎi xiànchéng de yě hǎo.
right.english: If there's no time, buying ready-made works too.

text.traditional: 氣象局說後面還有颱風，我們趁今天放晴去超市多買些乾糧也好。
text.simplified: 气象局说后面还有台风，我们趁今天放晴去超市多买些干糧也好。
text.pinyin: Qìxiàngjú shuō hòumiàn hái yǒu táifēng, wǒmen chèn jīntiān fàngqíng qù chāoshì duō mǎi xiē gānliáng yě hǎo.
text.english: The weather bureau says another typhoon is behind; it might as well be good for us to take advantage of today's clear skies to buy dry provisions.

text.traditional: 既然戶外活動取消了，大家趁這個機會留在家裡看書、充實自己也好。
text.simplified: 既然户外活动取消了，大家趁这个机会留在家里看书、充实自己也好。
text.pinyin: Jìrán hùwài huódòng qǔxiāo le, dàjiā chèn zhège jīhuì liú zài jiā lǐ kànshū, chōngshí zìjǐ yě hǎo.
text.english: Since outdoor activities are canceled, everyone staying home to read and enrich themselves might be good too.

text.traditional: 兒子問媽媽：我可以找朋友來我們社區烤肉嗎？媽媽笑著說：也好，熱鬧一下！
text.simplified: 儿子问妈妈：我可以找朋友来我们社区烤肉吗？妈妈笑着说：也好，热闹一下！
text.pinyin: Érzi wèn māma: Wǒ kěyǐ zhǎo péngyǒu lái wǒmen shèqū kǎoròu ma? Māma xiào zhe shuō: Yě hǎo, rènào yíxià!
text.english: Son asked mother: Can I invite friends to barbecue in our community? Mother smiled and said: That works too, add some festive cheer!

dialogue.title: 對話 · Dialogue
dialogue.setting: 颱風過後的早晨 · Morning after the typhoon

text.traditional: 家豪，昨晚的颱風風雨好大，你家還好嗎？
text.simplified: 家豪，昨晚的台风风雨好大，你家还好吗？
text.english: Jiahao, last night's typhoon had such fierce wind and rain; is your home alright?

text.traditional: 別提了，半夜風大得把路樹都吹倒了，我家甚至還停電了兩三個小時！
text.simplified: 别提了，半夜风大得把路树都吹倒了，我家甚至还停电了两三个小时！
text.english: Don't mention it; in the middle of the night the wind was so strong it blew down street trees, and my house even had a blackout for two or three hours!

text.traditional: 幸好我家平時就準備了電池和手電筒，萬一停電也不用慌張。
text.simplified: 幸好我家平时就准备了电池和手电筒，万一停电也不用慌张。
text.english: Fortunately my family prepared batteries and flashlights in advance; in case of a power outage we don't need to panic.

text.traditional: 我一連打了好幾通電話給住在花蓮的表哥，但電話一直打不通，真讓人擔心。
text.simplified: 我一连打了好几通电话给住在花莲的表哥，但电话一直打不通，真让人担心。
text.english: I called my cousin living in Hualien several times in a row, but couldn't get through; it really makes one worried.

text.traditional: 我以為東部的情況會好一些，沒想到這次颱風在東部登陸，災情相當嚴重。
text.simplified: 我以为东部的情况会好一些，没想到这次台风在东部登陆，灾情相当严重。
text.english: I thought the situation in the east would be better, but unexpectedly this typhoon made landfall in the east, causing severe damage.

text.traditional: 新聞說花蓮部分山區發生了土石流，甚至連對外聯絡的鐵路也被大水沖斷了。
text.simplified: 新闻说花莲部分山区发生了土石流，甚至连对外联络的铁路也被大水冲断了。
text.english: News reports say mudslides occurred in parts of Hualien's mountains, and even the railway connecting outside was washed out by floodwaters.

text.traditional: 氣象局說後面可能還有另一個颱風形成，我們趁今天天氣放晴，也好趕快去超市補充足夠的乾糧和飲用水。
text.simplified: 气象局说后面可能还有另一个台风形成，我们趁今天天气放晴，也好赶快去超市补充足够的干糧和饮用水。
text.english: The weather bureau says another typhoon might form later; while the weather clears up today, it might be good for us to hurry to the supermarket to restock dry food and drinking water.

text.traditional: 好！我們一起去超市採購防颱物資吧。
text.simplified: 好！我们一起去超市采购防台物资吧。
text.english: Great! Let's go to the supermarket together to purchase typhoon prevention supplies.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: As a Result / Turned Out That
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Indicate an outcome or unexpected consequence of a previous action using 結果.
grammarPages.explanation: 結果 serves as a conjunction or noun introducing the eventual result of an action, frequently signaling an unanticipated or contrary outcome.

items.question: Can 結果 introduce the intention instead of outcome?
items.answer: No. 結果 marks the actual final result or consequence, often an unintended one.
items.wrongTraditional: 我想去看電影，結果是我的打算。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想去看电影，结果是我的打算。

right.traditional: 我想去買票，結果票已經賣完了。
right.simplified: 我想去买票，结果票已经卖完了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi piào, jiéguǒ piào yǐjīng màiwán le.
right.english: I wanted to buy a ticket, but as it turned out, tickets were already sold out.

items.question: How does 結果 differ from 所以?
items.answer: 所以 gives a direct logical reason-and-result; 結果 highlights the factual turn of events.
items.wrongTraditional: 因為下雨，結果我帶雨傘。
items.wrongSimplified: 因为下雨，结果我带雨伞。

right.traditional: 因為下雨，所以我帶雨傘。
right.simplified: 因为下雨，所以我带雨伞。
right.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ dài yǔsǎn.
right.english: Because it rained, I brought an umbrella.

text.traditional: 那一夜強烈的搖晃震碎了許多家園，結果造成了兩千多人不幸喪生。
text.simplified: 那一夜强烈的摇晃震碎了许多家园，结果造成了两千多人不幸喪生。
text.pinyin: Nà yí yè qiángliè de yáohuàng zhènsuì le xǔduō jiāyuán, jiéguǒ zàochéng le liǎng qiān duō rén búxìng sàngshēng.
text.english: That night's violent shaking shattered many homes, resulting unfortunately in over 2,000 fatalities.

text.traditional: 昨天我在夜市看上一件上衣，沒試穿就買了，結果回家穿上才發現尺寸太小。
text.simplified: 昨天我在夜市看上一件上衣，没试穿就买了，结果回家穿上才发现尺寸太小。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài yèshì kànshàng yí jiàn shàngyī, méi shìchuān jiù mǎi le, jiéguǒ huíjiā chuān shàng cái fāxiàn chǐcùn tài xiǎo.
text.english: Yesterday I took a fancy to a top at the night market and bought it without trying it on; as a result, I only found out it was too small after getting home.

text.traditional: 這幾個月很多人因為流感而住院了，我和家人出門都戴口罩，結果一整個冬天都沒生病。
text.simplified: 这几个月很多人因为流感而住院了，我和家人出门都戴口罩，结果一整个冬天都没生病。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè hěn duō rén yīnwèi liúgǎn ér zhùyuàn le, wǒ hé jiārén chūmén dōu dài kǒuzhào, jiéguǒ yì zhěng ge dōngtiān dōu méi shēngbìng.
text.english: These months many people were hospitalized for flu; my family and I wore masks when going out, and as a result didn't fall ill the entire winter.

items.prompt: Describing an unexpected result of rushing:

segments.traditional: 把重要的合約落在客廳桌上了。

result.traditional: 他出門時走得太急，結果把重要的合約落在客廳桌上了。
result.simplified: 他出门时走得太急，结果把重要的合约落在客厅桌上了。
result.pinyin: Tā chūmén shí zǒu de tài jí, jiéguǒ bǎ zhòngyào de héyuē là zài kètīng zhuō shàng le.
result.english: He walked out in too much of a rush, and as a result left the important contract behind on the living room table.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add an extreme or surprising example for emphasis using 甚至.
grammarPages.explanation: 甚至 introduces an extreme instance or unexpected escalation of a situation, often reinforced with 連…也/都….

items.question: Does 甚至 indicate an ordinary addition like 而且?
items.answer: 甚至 escalates to an extreme, surprising, or superlative degree beyond normal expectations.
items.wrongTraditional: 他會說英文甚至會說中文。
items.wrongSimplified: 他会说英文甚至会说中文。

right.traditional: 他會多種語言，甚至連古希臘文都懂。
right.simplified: 他会多种语言，甚至连古希腊文都懂。
right.pinyin: Tā huì duō zhǒng yǔyán, shènzhì lián gǔ xīlàwén dōu dǒng.
right.english: He knows multiple languages, he even understands Ancient Greek.

items.question: Where does 甚至 sit in relation to 連?
items.answer: 甚至 precedes 連 when paired together (甚至連…也/都…), escalating emphasis.

right.pinyin: Shènzhì lián xiǎoháizi dōu zhīdào.
right.english: Even children know this.

text.traditional: 地震過後，臺中與南投交通中斷，甚至連水電和通訊也完全癱瘓。
text.simplified: 地震过后，台中与南投交通中断，甚至连水电和通讯也完全癱瘓。
text.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu, Táizhōng yǔ Nántóu jiāotōng zhōngduàn, shènzhì lián shuǐdiàn hé tōngxùn yě wánquán tānhuàn.
text.english: After the earthquake, transport in Taichung and Nantou was severed; even water, electricity, and telecommunications were completely paralyzed.

text.traditional: 張小姐什麼動物都不怕，就是怕蛇，甚至連電視上的蛇圖片也害怕。
text.simplified: 张小姐什么动物都不怕，就是怕蛇，甚至连电视上的蛇图片也害怕。
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě shénme dòngwù dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà shé, shènzhì lián diànshì shàng de shé túpiàn yě hàipà.
text.english: Miss Zhang isn't afraid of any animals except snakes; she is even afraid of snake pictures on TV.

text.traditional: 馬老闆一忙起來，不但沒空吃飯，甚至連上廁所的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 马老闆一忙起来，不但没空吃饭，甚至连上厕所的时间都没有。
text.pinyin: Mǎ lǎobǎn yì máng qǐlái, búdàn méi kòng chīfàn, shènzhì lián shàng cèsuǒ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: Once Boss Ma gets busy, not only does he have no time to eat, he doesn't even have time to go to the restroom.

result.pinyin: Tā zǒulù shí jī bù lí shǒu, shènzhì guò mǎlù shí yě dīng zhe yíngmù kàn, fēicháng wēixiǎn.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Designate a geographic direction or area relative to a landmark using 以東/以西/以南/以北.
grammarPages.explanation: These directional compass terms denote the area or boundary lying to the east, west, south, or north of a specific geographical landmark.
grammarPages.pattern: Landmark + 以東 / 以西 / 以南 / 以北

complement.traditional: 有許多歷史悠久的古蹟。
complement.simplified: 有许多历史悠久的古迹。

items.question: Can 以東/西/南/北 stand without a landmark?
items.answer: These directional compass zones require a geographical point of reference (Landmark + 以東).

right.pinyin: Wǒmen zhù zài chēzhàn yǐ dōng.
right.english: We live to the east of the station.

items.question: Does 車站以東 mean only the spot right next to the station?
items.answer: No. Landmark + 以東 denotes the entire regional zone lying eastward of that boundary.
items.wrongTraditional: 他在車站以東的門口等我。
items.wrongSimplified: 他在车站以东的门口等我。

right.pinyin: Tā zài chēzhàn dōng mén děng wǒ.
right.english: He is waiting for me at the station's east gate.

text.traditional: 車站以北的地區比其他地區熱鬧，如果你想逛街購物，那裡真是個好去處。
text.simplified: 车站以北的地区比其他地区热闹，如果你想逛街购物，那里真是个好去处。
text.pinyin: Chēzhàn yǐ běi de dìqū bǐ qítā dìqū rènào, rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng guàngjiē gòuwù, nàlǐ zhēn shì ge hǎo qùchù.
text.english: The area north of the station is more bustling than other areas; if you want to shop, that is really a great destination.

text.traditional: 我覺得花蓮市以南到臺東這一段路的風景最美，值得推薦給喜歡旅遊的朋友。
text.simplified: 我觉得花莲市以南到台东这一段路的风景最美，值得推荐给喜欢旅游的朋友。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Huālián Shì yǐ nán dào Táidōng zhè yí duàn lù de fēngjǐng zuì měi, zhíde tuījiàn gěi xǐhuān lǚyóu de péngyǒu.
text.english: I feel the scenery from south of Hualien City to Taitung is the most scenic, well worth recommending to friends who love traveling.

text.traditional: 這個國家以西鄰接著廣闊的沙漠，氣候十分乾燥。
text.simplified: 这个国家以西邻接着广闊的沙漠，气候十分干燥。
text.pinyin: Zhège guójiā yǐ xī línjiē zhe guǎngkuò de shāmò, qìhòu shífēn gānzào.
text.english: To the west of this country borders an expansive desert; the climate is very arid.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 九二一地震與臺灣的韌性 · The 921 Earthquake and Taiwan's Resilience
grammarFocus: 以東 / 以西 / 以南 / 以北

text.traditional: 臺灣位於環太平洋地震帶上，板塊運動活躍，因此地震發生的頻率相當高。
text.simplified: 台湾位于环太平洋地震带上，板块运动活躍，因此地震发生的频率相当高。
text.english: Taiwan is located on the Circum-Pacific seismic belt with active plate tectonics, hence earthquake frequency is quite high.

text.traditional: 一九九九年九月二十一日凌晨，臺灣中部發生了規模七點三的大地震，史稱「九二一地震」。
text.simplified: 一九九九年九月二十一日凌晨，台湾中部发生了规模七点三的大地震，史稱「九二一地震」。
text.english: In the early morning of September 21, 1999, a magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck central Taiwan, known historically as the '921 Earthquake.'

text.traditional: 那一夜強烈的搖晃震碎了許多家庭的家園，結果造成了兩千多人不幸喪生，上萬棟房屋倒塌。
text.simplified: 那一夜强烈的摇晃震碎了许多家庭的家园，结果造成了两千多人不幸喪生，上万栋房屋倒塌。
text.english: That night's violent shaking shattered homes of many families, resulting unfortunately in more than 2,000 fatalities and thousands of collapsed houses.

text.traditional: 地震發生後，臺中與南投等重災區交通中斷，甚至連水電和通訊也完全癱瘓。
text.simplified: 地震发生后，台中与南投等重灾区交通中断，甚至连水电和通讯也完全癱瘓。
text.english: After the earthquake, transportation in hard-hit areas such as Taichung and Nantou was severed, and even water, electricity, and telecommunications were completely paralyzed.

text.traditional: 面對巨大的天災，全臺灣人民發揮了「有錢出錢、有力出力」的精神，國內外救援隊伍也迅速投入救災。
text.simplified: 面对巨大的天灾，全台湾人民发挥了「有钱出钱、有力出力」的精神，国内外救援队伍也迅速投入救灾。
text.english: Confronting this massive natural disaster, all Taiwanese displayed the spirit of 'contributing money and labor,' and rescue teams from home and abroad rapidly joined disaster relief.

text.traditional: 車站以南的中部災民在社會各界的溫暖支持下，齊心協力重建家園，展現了無比堅韌的生命力。
text.simplified: 车站以南的中部灾民在社会各界的温暖支持下，齐心协力重建家园，展现了无比坚韌的生命力。
text.english: Victims in central Taiwan south of the station rebuilt their homes with united efforts under warm support from all sectors of society, demonstrating immense resilience.
